messages:
Sam T.: FYI: planned background KV compaction + storage IO uplift and coldstart soak this Wed 2026-04-08 00:30-03:30 UTC. Purpose: reduce long-term tail by compaction + validate cold-start behavior after IO change. Affects dedicated storage pools in eu-north-1 and us-east-1. Hosted API control plane unaffected.

Priya M.: How invasive is the compaction? Any expected request errors or throttles?

Sam T.: Nodes will be drained one at a time per AZ, compaction runs, then rejoin. Expect increased disk i/o and CPU on compaction nodes -> potential p95/p99 bumps for background/bulk routes. We will deprioritize bulk traffic and run synthetic coldstart clients to measure latency. No auth/key changes.

Jonas K.: Rollout plan + rollback criteria?

Sam T.: Plan:
```
- Window: 00:30-03:30 UTC
- Stagger: per-AZ node drain, 10m compaction, 10m observe before next node
- Canary: start with one node in eu-north-1 (00:30) then mirror in us-east-1 (01:30)
- Traffic split: canary=3% -> 10% after canary OK
- Synthetic probes: coldstart client qps=50 per region
- Rollback if: error_rate > 0.6% for 2m OR p99 > 3s for 3m
```

InfraBot: Maintenance ticket created: https://internal/maintenance/2295000000 state: scheduled owner: @Sam T. notify: oncall slack_channel: #eng-sre

Oncall Aisha: I'll be covering that window. Pre-checks I'll run 30m prior: replica lag < 250ms, active compaction queue length < 50, disk util < 80%.

Priya M.: Can we exclude enterprise orgs with strict SLOs?

Sam T.: Yes, we'll place those org-ids on a compaction exclusion list. DM me the org-id if needed.

Jonas K.: Addendum: enable 5% TRACE sampling for coldstart requests if p99 > 1s. Also capture perf profiles for nodes that exceed 75% iowait.

Sam T.: Agreed. Extra mitigation: bump bulk priority backpressure threshold to 60% CPU so background jobs back off earlier. Also prewarm frequent prefixes after each node rejoins: POST https://infra/api/prewarm -d '{"prefixes": ["/org/", "/model/"]}'

Oncall Aisha: I'll post short status lines during the run: started / canary-eunorth OK / canary-useast issue (rollback) / finished. Keep thread tidy during observe windows.

Sam T.: We'll publish a post-run summary and update the compaction runbook with observed metrics + any changes to thresholds. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
